run_adsorbml_calculations: run the AdsorbMLRunner calculate method to find global minima adsorption energy for a chunk of slab-adsorbate systems
initialize_adsorbml_runner: create an AdsorbMLRunner instance with an ASE calculator, input data path, and optional relaxation parameters
write_adsorbml_results: write AdsorbML calculation results to a compressed JSON file using the write_results method
run_adsorbml_with_relaxed_slab: run AdsorbML calculations with place_on_relaxed_slab enabled to relax the bare slab before adsorbate placement
run_adsorbml_with_energy_model: run AdsorbML calculations using the adsorption energy model instead of reference ML energies
